event_detail: Kettle: the gripper, fingers closed on nothing, hovers above the kettle on the counter to the right of the stove for 4.8 s without descending to grasp it; at 44.8 s it drifts left away from the kettle.
evidence: Wrist camera shows the kettle sitting on the counter below the gripper at about the same distance in the first three frames and shifted to the right edge in the last, never between the fingers; the finger pads are closed together (empty) in every frame. Shoulder views show the arm stretched over the stove toward the right in nearly the same pose throughout. The kettle never leaves the counter and no burner is lit.
